question: Determine if the differential equation $\dfrac{dy}{dx} + y \tan x = \sin x$ is linear or not. Justify.
explanation:
Equation: $\dfrac{dy}{dx} + y \tan x = \sin x$

Form: $\dfrac{dy}{dx} + P(x)y = Q(x)$, where $P(x) = \tan x$, $Q(x) = \sin x$

It is a linear differential equation.

options.A: Linear, because it is of the form $\frac{dy}{dx}+P(x)y=Q(x)$
